Definition: to deride; by implication (as if imitating a foreigner) to speak unintelligibly
BiblicalUsage: 1) to mock, deride, ridicule; 1a) (Qal) to mock, deride, have in derision; 1b) (Niphal) to stammer; 1c) (Hiphil) to mock, deride
